product_metadata.title: Lux Hotel Microfiber Tailored Style Bed Skirt with Classic 14 Inch Drop Length, Twin, Black
features: Classic Style: Our tailored design features box pleats at each corner of the bed for a clean and contemporary look.
Specifications: The twin-size fits all twin beds and measures 39” x 75” and has a classic 14” drop
Elegant Storage: Our bed skirt hides box springs, bed frames, and legs you’d rather not be visible. The sleek design allows you to tuck things under your bed and keep them out of sight
Ideal Fabric: Made of top-quality 100% Polyester Microfiber, our bed skirt is machine washable. It is wrinkle-free, fade resistant, and extremely durable for years of use
Enhance Your Décor: This skirt is the perfect finishing touch to your bed. Pair it with matching pillow shams, and because it is a solid neutral color, it easily coordinates with most bedding sets
description: A bed just doesn’t look complete without the right finishing touches. Lux Hotel’s Microfiber Bed Skirt gives your room just what the name suggests, a Lux Hotel look. Made from a sturdy high-quality, pre-shrunk microfiber, our bed skirt is fade and wrinkle resistant. It looks fresh, wash after wash. The tailored design is a modern update to the traditional dust ruffle. The clean look works with just about all linens from modern comforter sets to traditional quilts and solid or patterned sheets. The classic 14” drop conceals unsightly box springs, platforms, or generic metal bed frames to give your space a pulled together look. Adding a bed skirt also allows you to use the area under your bed as additional storage, which is particularly helpful in smaller homes, apartments, and vacation homes. Add matching shams, and your bed is complete. Lux Hotel offers soft and beautiful bedding for a hotel look at home. Quick Tip: To remove any wrinkles, place the bed skirt in the dryer for five minutes with a damp washcloth on high heat.

details.Care instructions: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low heat. Remove promptly. Warm iron bed skirt drop as needed. Do not iron platform.
